fixture.finalTextRule: Subtitles, full speaker names and final captions: opaque glyph core tolerance 2 RGB. fixture.imageContribution: Only the selected image is replaced with a ready transparent native Canvas of equal dimensions, leaving rendering geometry and branches unchanged.
